headline: Egypt Central Bank Hikes Key Interest Rates by 100 Basis Points to 20%
summary: Egypt's central bank raised its benchmark interest rates by one percentage point to 20% and 21% on October 29 in a surprise move aimed at keeping inflation expectations anchored.
why: The Central Bank of Egypt regulates monetary policy in the Arab world's most populous nation, where borrowing costs and currency stability are closely watched by emerging market debt investors.

impacts.why: The central bank unexpectedly raised interest rates by 100 basis points to 20%.
